tei:div.tei:p: /nā tha maṅga la gdams pa gegs sel gyi man ngag ces bya ba// mgon po bkra shis la springs pa de res khams ma bde ba de srung ba lus la bcangs pa tshos 'brum pa min la che ni bsam/ gang du'ang dkon mchog gsum la skyabs su 'gro ba ngag tu ma nus kyang*/ yid kyi ma chags pa'i ngos khyed rang gi snying gi dbus su gdan seng ge sogs kyis bteg pa'i khri'i steng du skyob pa 'jig rten gsum gyi mgon po dang*/ nged dbyer med pa rdo rje 'chang gi cha lugs su bsgoms la/ yan lag bdun pa sogs mchod pa 'bul/ dus mtha'i mos gus kyi ngos nas bdag gi ma rgan sems can thams cad nad rigs bzhi brgya rtsa bzhi las grol nas rnam mkhyen sangs rgyas kyi go 'phang dus da lta nyid du thob par rjes su bzung zhes pa ngag 'don gyi ngos/ mnyam par 'jog pa 'dis 'brum nad phyi la don nas nang du mi ldog cing myur du nad las grol bar 'gyur/ za yig 'di yang nangs re bzhin mid pa dang*/ gnas skabs thams cad du bla ma la mos gus dang*/ rigs drug la snying rje skyed/ nged kyis dmigs pa sogs byed pa yod/ yang thun gsum bzhi gang lcogs la skyabs 'gro sems bskyed byas nas/ rang skad cig gi rdo rje rnal 'byor ma gsal bar bsgoms nas ku sā li'i tshogs gsog byed pa ni mgron byad ma gnod byed bkug nas ster ba dmigs pa dang po/ de nas yang rang rdo rje rnal 'byor mar gnas pa'i ngang nas/ 'khor 'das kyi mgron dang byad ma lha srung gnod byed bkug nas mdun du gral byas nas/ khyed rnams bdag sangs rgyas thob pa'i grogs yin 'dir bzhugs shig bdag gi che ba'i srog chung ba'i longs spyod 'bul lo byas nas phaṭ/ rgyab pas rang gi rnam shes nam mkhar sres/ ci byed rang gyis byas gnas lugs la 'jog dmigs pa gnyis pa/ yang 'khor 'das 'gron dang byad ma gnod byed thams cad bkug 'dus par bsam nas phaṭ byas pas/

lus zhig nas snying rgyal ba shākya thub par gyur/ lus thams cad 'phags pa nyan thos dang rang sangs rgyas sogs su gyur pas bskor ba'i gtso 'khor du gyur/ byang chub kyi shing la rgyab rten nas bzhugs/ chos gsungs pas gnod byed thams cad 'dir gnod pa skyel bar yong rgyu ma red bsam pa'i 'gyod pa skyes par bsgoms nas gnas lugs ngang la 'jog pa dmigs pa gsum pa'o// maṅgalaṃ//
